buffers.name: HUD_DISPLAY_DIGITS
consumers: Hud_ResetDisplayDigits clears the six digits and terminator.
Interaction_SynchronizeResponseState compares the six digits with the pending snapshot.
Render_BuildActorRecords converts the digits into HUD actor records.

buffers.name: INTERACTION_PENDING_DISPLAY_VALUE
buffers.initializer: Interaction_InitializePendingDisplayValue seeds ASCII 100000 followed by NUL.

synchronization.name: Interaction_SynchronizeResponseState
synchronization.comparison: After draining ACTOR_RESPONSE_COUNTER, compare the current six-byte display with the pending six-byte snapshot from most significant digit to least significant digit.
synchronization.update: When the pending digit is less than or equal to the current digit at the first difference, copy all six current bytes into the pending snapshot and set HUD_DISPLAY_UPDATE_PENDING. If the pending value is greater, leave both buffers unchanged.

evidence: Exact GNU m68k disassembly of Hud_ResetDisplayDigits at 0x001B0008
Cached Ghidra decompilation of Interaction_SynchronizeResponseState at 0x001B0078
Cached Ghidra decompilation of Interaction_InitializePendingDisplayValue at 0x001AFFE4
Render_BuildActorRecords reads the current display digits when constructing HUD records
qualification: The static contract establishes the two buffers and their update direction, but does not assign a narrower user-facing meaning such as score, reward, or inventory quantity.
conclusion: The formerly unnamed current HUD display buffer at 0x00FF7E29 is now canonical as HUD_DISPLAY_DIGITS. The synchronization path is directionally corrected: current display digits are promoted into the pending snapshot on monotonic advancement, not the reverse.
